  - Evidence: `except Exception as e: logger.warning(...); pushback = validation = explanation = cross_ok = False`. A transient API failure on call 200/N degrades the question silently (won't be retained, since `keep = cross_ok and (traits_yes >= 2)` evaluates False). With ~200 questions in the source pool and a 5% Anthropic transient failure rate, ~10 questions silently drop from retention. If retention then dips below `--retention-floor 100`, the script falls through to a fresh-Claude branch (line 594) at +$1 + 5 min — silent recovery from a silent failure.

- **`i498_phase4_judge.py:72-73` — silent score=None on judge parse failure cascades to silent drop in analyzer.**

A 5-10% Anthropic parse-error rate silently shrinks the by-cell sample without raising. The headline is an n=120-per-cell statistic; a 10% silent drop = 12 missing observations per cell, fundamentally changing the bootstrap CI without surfacing.
  - Impact: judge-noise headlines that survive due to coincidence of which cells got more parse failures. CLAUDE.md fail-fast violated.
  - Fix: count parse-failures per cell; raise if any cell loses >5% of its rows. Surface the failure rate in `analysis.json` headline summary.

The robustness check this is supposed to provide doesn't exist.

- **`i498_phase0_preflight.py` — intra-judge κ ≥ 0.85 pilot gate (plan §4.1 line 182) NEVER ENFORCED.**
  - Evidence: pilot dialogs are scored ONCE per dialog (line 412-447); the second-pass call required to compute Cohen's κ is not made; `pilot_summary` (line 730-742) reports trait-present-mean / trait-absent-mean only.
